description: This file defines various benchmark classes for reduction operations in tensor computations, including 1D and 2D reductions, with support for dynamic shapes and different reduction modes. It includes class definitions, methods for configuration, memory workload estimation, and registration of benchmark classes.

classes.name: ReduceBench
classes.description: Base class for reduction benchmarks, supporting different reduction modes and configurations.

classes.name: ReduceFullBench
classes.description: Benchmark class for full tensor reduction.

classes.name: Reduce2DBench
classes.description: Benchmark class for 2D reduction performance validation.

classes.name: DynamicReduce2DBench
classes.description: Dynamic shape version of 2D reduction benchmark.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the benchmark with mode, device, dtype, case, dimensions, and skip input transform.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the reduction operation on inputs.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Returns configuration parameters for the benchmark.

methods.name: module
methods.description: Returns the module name for the benchmark.

methods.name: memory_workload
methods.description: Estimates memory workload for the reduction operation.

methods.name: _set_skip_input_transform
methods.description: Sets whether to skip input transformation based on input string.

methods.name: _skip_input_transform_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of skip input transform state.

methods.name: instantiate_input
methods.description: Generates input with random shape for dynamic benchmarks.
